init_WandbLogger: create a WandbLogger instance with a save directory, project name, and optional resume flag
log_hyperparams: log experiment hyperparameters as a dictionary or argparse Namespace into the wandb run config
log_metrics: log a dictionary of metrics with optional prefix and step number to wandb
log_audio: log a torch tensor audio clip with sample rate to wandb as a wandb.Audio object
from_xp: create a WandbLogger from a dora experiment context with automatic resume and config detection
